{"id":"mimid-1wgh.37.90.41","title":"wg: partial-02 L499 The draft supports processing new_member_commit, but the list of...","description":"draft-ietf-mls-partial (partial-02), Annotated Commit. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-partial at 7fef7c1, L499.

Text: "When applying proposals, only the proposals that do not modify the tree are
    applied, in particular, PreSharedKey and GroupContextExtensions proposals."

Problem: The draft supports processing new_member_commit, but the list of applied proposals omits ExternalInit, which determines the new init_secret. An implementation that reads "in particular" as exhaustive derives the wrong epoch for external Commits.

Suggested fix: Name ExternalInit explicitly among the applied proposals, or make the list explicitly non-exhaustive ("e.g.").

Severity: medium. Verifier: narrow (Open PR #7 already adds AppDataUpdate and AppEphemeral to the list, and handles the removed-receiver case by making receiver_membership_proof_after optional. The uncovered part is ExternalInit, which is needed for new_member_commit (supported at lines 492 and 509) to derive init_secret. Neither the text nor PR #7 names it.)
